name: Resistor divider
description: A two-resistor divider whose junction carries the divided output.

parameters.name: topRef
parameters.description: Reference designator for the high-side resistor.

parameters.name: bottomRef
parameters.description: Reference designator for the low-side resistor.

parameters.name: pcbX
parameters.description: Module position on the board, in millimetres.

parameters.name: pcbY
parameters.description: Module position on the board, in millimetres.

parameters.name: schX
parameters.description: Module position on the schematic sheet.

parameters.name: schY
parameters.description: Module position on the schematic sheet.

notes: The divider loads the source it measures; pick values for the source impedance and the current you can spend.
Resistor power rating is not checked. analyze_power reports dissipation only when a build emits a DC operating point.
